I used the plan below. Roads and evacuation points shape it as follows.

- **Evacuation point:** Only Kispang shelter counts. Galchhi temple is not designated, so people cannot be dropped there.
- **Myagang temple (8 people):** The road is 16 minutes each way, so each car makes a 32-minute round trip carrying 4. Car1 takes the 3 injured and 1 elderly. Car2 takes the other elderly and the 3 adults. Both trips are worth it, since deferring even one car's group would cost more than 32.
- **Galchhi temple (4 children):** The route is Kispang → Gosaikunda → Galchhi and back, an 82-minute round trip. Deferring the children would cost 240, so car2 goes after its Myagang trip.
- **Dupcheshwar temple (1 elderly):** The round trip is 52 minutes, against a deferral penalty of 50, so I defer.
- **Tadi market and Naukunda farm:** The only road into Tadi from the rest of the network is the flooded Tadi–Galchhi road, and Naukunda connects only through Tadi. Neither can be reached, so I defer the 3 injured at Tadi (240) and the 2 adults at Naukunda (40).

<plan>
drive car1 kispang-shelter myagang-temple
load car1 injured 3
load car1 elderly 1
drive car1 myagang-temple kispang-shelter
unload car1 injured 3
unload car1 elderly 1
drive car2 kispang-shelter myagang-temple
load car2 elderly 1
load car2 adult 3
drive car2 myagang-temple kispang-shelter
unload car2 elderly 1
unload car2 adult 3
drive car2 kispang-shelter gosaikunda-temple
drive car2 gosaikunda-temple galchhi-temple
load car2 child 4
drive car2 galchhi-temple gosaikunda-temple
drive car2 gosaikunda-temple kispang-shelter
unload car2 child 4
defer dupcheshwar-temple elderly 1
defer naukunda-farm adult 2
defer tadi-market injured 3
</plan>
COST: 476
